$comment: MCP server card per the .well-known discovery convention (RFC 8615; MCP SEP drafts). The discovery schema is still settling, so this card sticks to the fields every draft agrees on: what the server is, where it listens, how to speak to it.
name: knowbase
description: Verified engineering-failure knowledge. Look an error up from its message or stack trace, narrow it to one root cause via per-cause discriminators, and report whether the fix held. Every entry cites primary sources whose quotes are machine-verified against the live pages.

tools.name: knowbase_lookup
tools.description: Paste an error message, code, or stack trace; returns matching entries with root causes, discriminators and exclusions inlined. Answers honestly with match=none when the corpus does not cover it.

tools.name: knowbase_diagnose
tools.description: Given an entry and your observed discriminator results, returns which root cause your observations identify and why the others are ruled out.

tools.name: knowbase_report_outcome
tools.description: Report whether the applied fix held. Outcomes feed re-verification of the entry, not its published confidence.
